tokens.v: Note
The commands only read.
Nothing in LN is changed, and there is nowhere to type a question. Each answer is written by a language model from data LN sends it, so a wrong answer reads like a right one.

tokens.v: A prepared question, attached to a screen.
Someone writes the question once, chooses the LN data that goes with it, and links it to one session. Everyone who uses that session then sees it as a command in the
Actions
menu. Choosing it sends the selected record to the Infor GenAI service, and the answer opens in a window of its own.

sections.text: The GenAI Embedded Experience feature must be switched on for the tenant first, in the CloudSuite Self-Service Portal, by someone with its Admin role. Until it is, no command appears anywhere. Then three things are built, in this order, all under Tools ➔ Application Extensibility ➔ Embedded GenAI, and Set up a GenAI prompt walks each one.
